C0571.title: Supermarket Delivery Driver Sentenced for Abusing 30,000+ Virtual Phone Numbers to Obtain New-User Subsidies and Delivery Fees
C0571.summary: A supermarket delivery driver exploited a platform vulnerability by using more than 30,000 virtual phone numbers to mass-register fake new-user accounts, fraudulently obtaining merchant coupons and delivery fees. According to the Zhenjiang District People's Court of Shaoguan, the defendant completed over 30,000 orders from May 2022 to August 2024, obtained more than 410,000 yuan in new-user subsidies and more than 320,000 yuan in delivery fees, and was sentenced to ten years and ten months in prison for fraud.
